purpose: Clinical indication universe for scientific mapping. No new prescribing rule is activated by this file.

rows.indication: Odontogenic or post-operative dental pain
rows.gap: Current Moroccan product-level RCP/risk mapping must be completed before widening automation.

rows.indication: Localised dental abscess without spreading or systemic involvement
rows.gap: M0 must preserve drainage/removal-of-cause priority and prevent antibiotic suggestion solely from the word abscess.

rows.indication: Dental abscess with spreading infection or systemic involvement
rows.gap: Current Moroccan molecule-specific regimen and hierarchy must be adjudicated before activation.

rows.indication: Severe odontogenic infection with airway/deep-space or other emergency red flags
rows.gap: Requires explicit Moroccan emergency pathway; outpatient dose logic must never substitute for referral.

rows.indication: Necrotising gingivitis or necrotising periodontitis
rows.gap: Current Moroccan indication-specific regimen and diagnostic terminology pending.

rows.indication: Pericoronitis
rows.gap: Current Moroccan indication-specific protocol pending; no automatic antibiotic for uncomplicated pericoronitis.

rows.indication: Mild/localised oral candidosis or denture-associated candidosis
rows.gap: Moroccan oral presentations, RCP indications and interaction rules pending.

rows.indication: Severe/extensive oral candidosis or failure of appropriate topical management
rows.gap: Moroccan indication, dose, host-risk and interaction rules pending.

rows.indication: Angular cheilitis
rows.gap: Must distinguish candidal/mixed disease from clearly bacterial disease; Moroccan fusidic-acid/topical combination evidence not yet mapped.

rows.indication: Mild primary herpetic gingivostomatitis
rows.gap: Moroccan supportive-care product evidence and age rules pending.

rows.indication: Severe oral herpes simplex or infection in an immunocompromised patient
rows.gap: Moroccan oral-HSV RCP indication, dose and referral threshold pending.

rows.indication: Mild herpes labialis in a non-immunocompromised patient
rows.gap: Moroccan topical indication/regimen must be confirmed from RCP.

rows.indication: Diagnosed oral mucosal ulceration/inflammation suitable for symptomatic topical care
rows.gap: Diagnosis-specific Morocco evidence and off-label boundaries pending.

rows.indication: Persistent or suspicious oral ulcer
rows.gap: Referral/biopsy pathway must be handled outside routine pharmacology automation.

rows.indication: High caries risk requiring prescription-strength fluoride prevention
rows.gap: Moroccan product status, age limits and medicinal/device/cosmetic classification pending.

rows.indication: Symptomatic dry mouth/xerostomia
rows.gap: Underlying-cause workflow and Morocco product/classification evidence pending.

rows.indication: Dental patient requiring local haemostasis while taking anticoagulant/antiplatelet therapy
rows.gap: Must be integrated with procedure bleeding-risk and antithrombotic management; local tranexamic use may be off-label.

rows.indication: Infective endocarditis antibiotic prophylaxis around invasive dental procedures
rows.gap: Older Moroccan academic material is inconsistent with modern international guidance; current authoritative Moroccan protocol is required before encoding.

rows.indication: Dental anxiety requiring pharmacological premedication
rows.gap: Requires Moroccan legal/prescription constraints, dose protocol, escort/driving and sedation-safety rules.

rows.indication: Temporomandibular disorder or non-odontogenic facial pain
rows.gap: Must not reuse odontogenic pain rules for neuropathic/TMD pain without diagnosis-specific evidence.

rows.indication: Acute sinusitis encountered in dental differential diagnosis
rows.gap: Requires diagnosis and medical/ENT guidance; kept in universe to prevent incorrect dental-antibiotic reuse.

rows.indication: Medical emergency in the dental practice
rows.gap: Must remain a separate emergency module with Moroccan stock/protocol/legal validation.
